latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of autonomous Shopify purchasing using Stripe Link and Playwright.
- Search products across all Shopify merchants or directly from a specific store.
- Generate one-time payment cards via Stripe Link CLI, with user approval workflow.
- Complete end-to-end checkout on any Shopify store using headless browser automation.
- Includes robust error handling, address autofill, proper phone validation, and modal dismissal techniques.
- Designed for requests like "buy me X" or "order X from Shopify", requiring necessary authentication and environment setup.
